why: In section 4 the reader says the two oranges in the cost bar (buying/selling commission and custody fee) "look almost the same colour to me on a phone". That says two colours are too alike to tell apart. It comes after about eight earlier problems: the Psagot price doubt, the foreign fund line, the inflation question, "pair", the extra tax, the trustee/variable terms, the step chart's starting point and the repeated lists.
